name: Decibel usDCBL
notes: Decibel primary materials now establish that the protocol-native usDCBL economic model is live on mainnet. Decibel identifies Bridge as issuer and describes usDCBL as a USD-denominated stablecoin used inside the protocol; exact reserve composition, holder redemption rights, legal claim, contract identity and issuer affiliate must remain source-bounded during full-layer promotion.
